environment.description: Spring Boot service deployed on EC2 in a public subnet with an Application Load Balancer (internet-facing). Security groups allow inbound 443 from 0.0.0.0/0. Users authenticate via HTTP Basic over TLS. The service is registered in an internal service catalog but the ALB is publicly routable. PostgreSQL RDS backend with no row-level security. Spring Security relies solely on role-based access from the 'role' column in the users table.

config.auth: HTTP Basic, roles from DB column
